1 · Intro

When to use it.

FERPA, the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act, protects the privacy of student education records at schools that receive federal education funds.

HCMs see student information when they hire and pay student workers, so you need to know what you may see and share.

Use this whenYou are working with a student worker's record or someone asks you for information about a student.

2 · Walk through

What to know.

Check off each item as you read.

Watch-outs

  • Do not confirm a student's class schedule, grades, or enrollment details to a caller, parent, or outside employer.
  • A student who opted out of directory information must not have even directory details released.
  • Open item: confirm Vanderbilt's FERPA office or Registrar contact, the required FERPA training, and how student worker records are classified.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

HCM Academy job aid · Start Here

FERPA Tutorial for Staff

Use when: You are working with a student worker's record or someone asks you for information about a student. · System: Overview

  1. Know what an education record is.
  2. Access requires a legitimate educational interest.
  3. Student worker records may be education records.
    • Treat student worker files with FERPA care.
  4. Directory information has limits.
  5. Get written consent for other disclosures.
  6. Do not pass information along.

Watch-outs

  • Do not confirm a student's class schedule, grades, or enrollment details to a caller, parent, or outside employer.
  • A student who opted out of directory information must not have even directory details released.
  • Open item: confirm Vanderbilt's FERPA office or Registrar contact, the required FERPA training, and how student worker records are classified.
